new_events.actor: Saudi Arabia / Yemen internationally recognized government
new_events.summary: Reuters reported that Saudi Arabia was planning a Yemeni-led offensive against the Houthis, with options ranging from a focused coastal push around Bab el-Mandeb to broader synchronized operations. Sources said Saudi air support and U.S. intelligence were expected, while no launch date had been fixed.

UKMTO said the master of a crude oil tanker reported the vessel was struck by an unknown projectile about four nautical miles east of Oman. All crew were reported safe and no environmental impact was reported; attacker and weapon type were unresolved.

Gaza health and civil-defence officials said an Israeli strike on a Gaza City apartment building killed at least five Palestinians, including four women. Israel separately said it carried out an overnight strike intended to kill Hamas political official Ali al-Amoudi, but it was not immediately clear whether that was the same strike.

existing_event_updates.summary: Saudi policy moved beyond defensive response toward reported planning for a ground offensive led by Yemeni forces to reverse Houthi territorial gains around Bab el-Mandeb. Timing and final scope remained undecided.

claims_and_corrections.actor: Regional and Western officials speaking to Reuters
claims_and_corrections.claim: Saudi Arabia is preparing a Yemeni-led offensive against Houthi-held territory with Saudi air support.

economic_energy_updates.summary: A new projectile strike on a tanker just east of Oman reinforced continuing physical risk around Gulf shipping despite improving export volumes.

source_discovery_additions.addition: UKMTO report of an Oct. 2 tanker projectile incident east of Oman.
